description: This file defines the `ThingId` class, which represents a validated identifier for a 'thing' within the Eclipse Ditto project. It provides static methods to create instances from strings, namespaces, or by generating new UUID-based IDs, and includes constants for dummy IDs. It extends the `NamespacedEntityIdWithType` class and overrides methods related to entity type identification.

classes.name: ThingId
classes.description: A final class representing a validated ID for a 'thing' in the Eclipse Ditto project, extending NamespacedEntityIdWithType and providing utility methods for creation and identification.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a ThingId instance from a CharSequence, possibly returning the same instance if input is already a ThingId, or wrapping the creation in validation.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a ThingId with a specific namespace and name.

methods.name: inDefaultNamespace
methods.description: Creates a ThingId with a default namespace placeholder based on a name.

methods.name: generateRandom
methods.description: Generates a new dummy ThingId with a UUID-based name.

methods.name: getEntityType
methods.description: Overrides method to return the entity type indicating this ID is for a 'thing'.
